between the hours of 1:30 pm and 5:00 pm in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. the prevailing time at The Leroy F. Smith Building, 60 West Market Street, 14th Floor, Newark, NJ 07102 to wit:

BEGINNING AT A POINT ON THE WESTERLY LINE OF EAST PASSAIC AVENUE AT A POINT THEREIN 50.23 FEET NORTHERLY FROM THE INTERSECTION OF THE SAME AND THE NORTHERLY LINE OF LEO TERRACE AND FROM THENCE RUNNING (THIS CONCISE DESCRIPTION DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A LEGAL DESCRIPTION. A COPY OF THE FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION CAN BE FOUND AT THE OFFICE OF THE SHERIFF.) PURSUANT TO A TAX SEARCH OF 2/23/26; 2025 TAXES: $12,668.56 BILLED; $9,589.47 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $3,079.09 PAID, 2026 QTR 1 DUE: 02/01/2026 $3,167.14 OPEN PLUS PENALTY, 2026 QTR 2 DUE: 05/01/2026 $3,167.14 OPEN. VACANT LOT CHARGE: PROPERTY REGISTRATION FEE $500.00 OPEN AND DUE 3/11/26. PLEASE CONTACT FIRE DEPARTMENT AT 973-680-4153 FOR DETAILS. WATER ACCT: 5810100 0 TO: 01/12/2026 $118.65 PAID SUBJECT TO FINAL READING. SEWER: INCLUDED WITH TAXES. GENERAL REMARK: SUBJECT TO TAX SALE. SUBJECT TO ADDITIONAL FEES MISCELLANEOUS 6% YEAR END PENALTY: 2025 $611.92 OPEN PLUS PENALTY.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
698 EAST PASSAIC AVE BLOOMFIELD, NJ 07003
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Essex County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Essex County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $179,992.53 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Amir D. Jones
SHERIFF
